historical_terminal_consensus.verdict: The cyclotomic tower Q^ab = colim_n Q(zeta_n) with n* = 120 carries all algebra, kinematics, and discrete dynamics across all 22 foundational targets with zero floating-point drift. However, the uniqueness of the Born rule requires continuous sphere topology S^(d-1) and cannot be derived algebraically from finite frame additivity.
